label: Criticality and net weights
subgoals: Take each net's worst slack from the timing report
Map slack to criticality between 0 and 1
Raise the net weight with alpha times criticality to the beta

label: Weighted wirelength and its effect
subgoals: Multiply each net's wirelength by its weight in the objective
Solve the weighted placement and compare with the unweighted one
Check that total wirelength stays close while critical nets shorten

label: Keeping weights current
subgoals: Re-run timing at fixed milestones and update the weights
Blend new weights with old ones to avoid oscillation
Delay the first update until cells have spread
